title: Namhae German Village
description: Namhae German Village is a village where miners and nurses stationed in Germany settled after returning home after retirement. You can see traditional German-style houses and Korean-Germans living here. Of these, about 30 are running guesthouses as a side business. It is said that many tourists visit each house for its unique interior design and service. Right in front of you is the cool sea of ​​the seawall and the Mulmi Coastal Road, the most beautiful coastal drive course on the southern coast.

title: Naeri Cultural Park
description: Naeri Cultural Park is a space where local residents can enjoy culture and nature at the same time. It is located in a place where you can see Anseongcheon Stream. It is popular with families as it has a large lawn and bicycle path. Various performances and events are held in the lawn yard. You can go up to the observatory and relax while looking at the water of Anseongcheon Stream. In fall, flowers bloom in the pink muli garden, making it a great place to take pictures. The Naeri camping site is located right next to it.

title: Naesosa Temple (Buan)
description: Naesosa Temple was built by Hyegu Duta in 633 (the 34th year of King Mu of Baekje), and its original name was Sorae Temple. Daeungbojeon is a Buddhist temple that enshrines Bodhisattva Bodhisattva and Bodhisattva Bodhisattva on the left and right with Sakyamuni at the center. It is said to have been built by the Great Master Cheongmin in the 11th year of King Injo of the Joseon Dynasty (1633) when he was renovating the temple. The size is 3 rooms in the front and 3 rooms on the sides, and the roof is a gable roof in the shape of the characters 8 (八). The decorative structure to support the eaves of the roof is not only on the pillars but also between pillars in the multi-layer style, and the overlapping appearance of the members extending outward clearly shows the characteristics of architecture in the mid-Joseon Dynasty. In addition, you can get a glimpse of the excellent carving skills of the time in the flower gates of Daeungbojeon, and on the rear wall behind the Buddha statue, there is a seated white-robed Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, the largest one left in Korea.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Drama <Daejanggeum> In the drama 'Daejanggeum', the impressive scene where Janggeum throws a stone while looking at the pond, and Min Jeong-ho watches it, was filmed in the pond on the grounds of Naesosa Temple. The beautiful scenery around the pond along with the quiet temple atmosphere captures the emotions of the drama more deeply.
address: Naesosa Ticket Office, 191 Naesosa-ro, Buan-gun, Jeollabuk-do
priceDetail: Free

title: Yellow Bridge Museum
description: Gapyeong Yellow Bridge Museum is a private art museum set in the forest, where works made of various materials are naturally displayed, and the works can also be viewed in the museum's indoor garden. There is a cafe inside the museum, and the admission fee includes one drink and a cookie snack, and you can enjoy tea while relaxing among the artwork. This place is also known as ‘Gapyeong Travel Destination with Children’, which means that children will also like it. As the name of the museum suggests, the entrance is across the yellow bridge and is decorated so cutely and stylishly that it becomes a popular photo spot. The indoor garden is worth seeing as the works are naturally mixed in with well-trimmed trees. It is quite large and has a space where children can draw and display pictures. In the museum, you can feel nature such as trees, flowers, and birds, so the museum itself is like a forest and a work of art. There is also a valley at the entrance of the museum, where you can relax and feel nature.
price: Adult 9,000 won, Child 5,000 won, Dog 1,000 won

title: Noseongsan
description: This mountain is a low mountain 310 meters above sea level that forms the border between Seolseong-myeon, Icheon-si, Gyeonggi-do, and Iljuk-myeon, Anseong-si. When you exit Iljuk IC on the Jungbu Expressway and head toward Janghowon, the low mountain you see on the left is Noseongsan Mountain. It is a mountain behind the neighborhood where one can assume that there are no beautiful rocks or rock ridges at all, but there are various strangely shaped rocks such as Oyster Rock, Folding Screen Rock, Horsehead Rock, and Lonely Rock, and there is also a citizen's park under the mountain. The starting point of the hike is the parking lot of Citizens' Park in Geumdang-ri, Seolseong-myeon, Icheon-si, in the north. It only takes 2 hours, including breaks, to go around the mountain and come back down. This mountain has three names, including Nosongsan, Noseungsan, and Noseongsan, but the official administrative name is Noseongsan. It was marked as 310m by referring to the summit marker and information board installed locally. As the first name suggests, Isan has an unusually large number of pine trees. Citizen's Park is the starting point for hiking, and the hiking trail is well-maintained using trees and railway timbers. Not only are there many strangely shaped rocks here and there, but the evening water flows between the cracks in the rocks of Byeongpungbawi Rock and Byeongmokan, providing drinking water. The view from the summit is unobstructed in all directions, and if you climb up on the observatory rock just below the summit, the view of Wongyeongsa Temple and Geumdang Reservoir is even more beautiful. It truly deserves to be called Icheon's Little Salt River, and is suitable for a family-friendly recreational hiking destination.

title: Noksu Valley
description: Noksu Valley, located in Deokhyeon-ri, Sang-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, is a valley composed of clear, clean water and tall dense forests that flows along the beautiful Cheongwu Mountain (619m) and the clear and clean Jojongcheon Stream. Water flows along the flat land, and the river is wide, deep, and has an abundance of water, making it feel like a riverside rather than a valley in the forest. You can climb to the small Noksubong Peak (370m) along the valley, and the nearby Gitdaebong Peak, Cheongwusan Mountain, Bulgisan Mountain, and Daegeumsan Mountain are connected by a ridge, so you can also hike along the ridge. Low banks are built in the middle of the valley to occasionally stop the flow of water, dividing it into areas where the flow is fast and areas where the water stagnates and is suitable for swimming. There are people who manage safety for each section and lend life jackets. As you go upstream, the width of the valley becomes narrower and the water is deeper, so you must be careful when playing in the water. There is no separate parking lot, so you may park your car on the side of the road upstream. There are some people who cook around the river, but this is a no-cooking area, so cooking is not allowed. Playing in the water in Noksu Valley is good any time of the year: spring, summer, or fall.

title: Agricultural Relics Exhibition Hall
description: The Agricultural Relics Exhibition Hall in front of the Paju Agricultural Technology Center was established with the purpose of raising pride in our culture and promoting a proper understanding of agriculture in future generations through tours of our disappearing traditional agricultural cultural heritage. The exhibition hall is 1 floor underground and 3 floors above ground, and displays about 500 agricultural relics and 200 straw crafts along with related photos and sculptures. The relics come from various eras and regions, from prehistoric times to the Joseon Dynasty, and you can see a variety of farming-related tools and equipment, farming equipment, agricultural products, and straw crafts in one place. The main artifacts on display in this exhibition hall include plowing tools, boiling tools, seeding tools, weeding tools, fertilizing tools, watering tools, harvesting tools, threshing tools, drying tools, mill tools, carrying tools, harvesting tools, livestock farming tools, straw and grass processing tools, food processing tools, weaving tools, and weighing tools.

title: New Core Outlet Ilsan Branch
venue: Goyang New Core Outlet Ilsan Branch
description: New Core Outlet Ilsan Branch is a shopping complex centered on fashion and miscellaneous goods located in Madu-dong. There are many E-Land retail brands such as Kim's Club, Modern House, and Luxury Gallery, and it also has a wide range of clothing and household goods for each age group. The 9th floor cultural center is used as a space for local residents’ hobbies and educational programs. It is also comprised of family restaurants, specialty restaurants, and a food mall, making it a great place to enjoy shopping and dining out in one place.

title: New Core Outlet Pyeongchon Branch
venue: Anyang New Core Outlet Pyeongchon Branch
description: New Core Outlet Pyeongchon Branch is an urban outlet that has been operating in the same location since opening as ‘Kim’s Outlet’ in 1997. It has excellent accessibility as it is directly connected to Beomgye Station on Subway Line 4, and the store structure and circulation were completely reorganized through a major renewal in May 2025. Approximately 260 fashion and miscellaneous goods brands, specialty restaurants, Shupen, Kim's Club, etc. are operated, allowing a variety of products and services to be used in one place. A CGV movie theater and cultural center are also included, so you can enjoy both shopping and leisure. It has a large parking space and efficient circulation, making it highly convenient for visitors.

title: Nijimori Studio
description: Nijimori Studio is a themed cultural complex that reproduces classic Japanese street scenes and the unique sensibility of the Taisho era. It is located in a location that is easily accessible from Seoul and the metropolitan area, and its exterior and interior design with a Japanese street motif embodies a unique concept that is rare in Korea. All elements of the space, including signs, shops, street lighting, and vending machines, faithfully reflect the Japanese retro atmosphere, allowing visitors to have an immersive experience as if they were actually in Japan. This space goes beyond a simple theme park and offers a variety of content such as YouTube videos, advertisements, music videos, SNS content, fashion pictorials, and wedding photography. It is also actively used as a location for production. It is operated not only for filming rentals but also as an experiential space for general visitors, so it is attracting attention as a famous place for the MZ generation and creators to take the best shot of their lives, and as an optimal place for branded content production for brands and planners. Combining differentiated spatiality and content utilization, Nijimori Studio is a place with a strong competitive edge for projects that require emotional and original visuals.

title: Tea Ceremony Museum
description: Gimpo Tea Ceremony Museum is a private museum specializing in traditional tea ceremony that was opened to shed new light on the cultural history of Korean tea. It is equipped with auxiliary facilities such as a sculpture park, Paldojangdok exhibition, and a gallery on a site of approximately 10,000 pyeong. Behind the museum, a dense forest surrounds it like a folding screen, making it feel like a painting. It is a complex cultural and artistic space that satisfies cultural needs by holding various cultural events and performances, including planning and exhibiting various special exhibitions two to three times a year to reproduce the living, breathing scenes of etiquette and tea culture history and to satisfy the cultural desires of the general public. Children, teenagers, general citizens, and foreigners can receive education on tea ceremonies and traditional etiquette experiences that can help with character education. A pavilion, an ecological pond, and a lawn garden have been created where they can relax in nature, and they can also experience folk games (Tuhorye, Jegichagi, Yutnori, etc.).

title: Dasan Sports Park (Sports Park No. 1 Sports Facility) Soccer Field
venue: Namyangju Dasan Sports Park (Sports Park No. 1 Sports Facility) Soccer Field
description: Dasan Sports Park Soccer Field is a recreational sports facility located in Dasan-dong, Namyangju-si. All elements, including the size of the soccer field and goalposts, are of the regular size, and the turf is always maintained in optimal condition. In addition to the soccer field, the park has several sports facilities, including tennis courts and foot volleyball courts, which citizens can conveniently use by making reservations. The large site also has a park-like space, making it ideal for taking a walk after exercising or resting in nature.

title: Dankook University Seok Juseon Memorial Museum
venue: Seok Ju-seon Memorial Museum, Dankook University, Pyeongtaek
description: This is a museum commemorating the achievements of Dr. Seok Ju-seon (1911-1996) of Nansa, located on the Jukjeon Campus of Dankook University. The Department of History, which was established with the opening of the school in 1947, conducted regular or frequent field trips every year from the beginning and collected many relics, and based on this, an archeology room was established on September 1, 1961. Afterwards, it was launched as the university-affiliated central museum on November 3, 1967, immediately after the university was promoted to a comprehensive university. On May 2, 1981, Dr. Seok Ju-seon, an authority in the field of Korean clothing history, donated 3,365 pieces of folk relics (costumes) collected throughout his life, and the school opened the Seok Ju-seon Memorial Folk Museum to commemorate his noble spirit and contributions, and to educate the future and develop and preserve national cultural assets through research and preservation of folk relics. On March 26, 1999, ''Central Museum'' and ''Seok Juseon Memorial Folk Museum'' were merged and the name was renamed to ''Seok Juseon Memorial Museum'', which continues to this day. Dr. Seok Ju-seon, a pioneer in the field of Korean clothing history and an authority in folklore studies, donated 3,365 pieces of traditional clothing and folk relics collected throughout his life. The museum is largely divided into an archaeological museum and a folk costume museum. The first floor has a total of five exhibition halls, and the second floor is a research and data room with facilities such as an artifact restoration and conservation science laboratory and a convention hall. It houses a total of 40,000 artifacts, of which about 1,500 are on display. In particular, 11 items and 100 pieces of relics, including An Jung-geun's ink (treasure) and Princess Deokon's dangui, have been designated as important folk cultural properties, and diplomat Lee Beom-jin's [Missage Log], which records his activities as an envoy to the United States, has been designated as a nationally registered cultural property. It takes about 8 minutes by car from Jukjeon Station on the Suin Bundang Line, and there is a bus that goes from the station to the campus. Nearby are the Gyeonggi Provincial Museum, Gyeonggi Provincial Children's Museum, and Korean Folk Village.

title: Danyang Gosu Cave
description: Danyang Gosu Cave (Natural Monument), located at 8 Gosu Cave-gil, Danyang-eup, Danyang-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, is one of the mysterious and beautiful natural caves. Inside the 1,700m long cave, there are many things to see, including stalactites, stalagmites, cave corals, cave pearls, natural bridges, and aragonite, a rare stalactite. It is no exaggeration to say that you can see almost anything that is created in a limestone cave. The highlight of Gosu Cave is the amazing scenery created by nature and time, including Lion Rock, Dodamsambong Rock, Mary Statue, and Love Rock. In particular, Course B, which had been restricted from viewing, has been opened to the public since April 2013, adding to the attractions. It is a good educational place for children as they can get a glimpse of ancient nature and prehistoric life.

title: Danyang Danuri Aquarium
description: Danuri Center, which stands tall on the winding Namhan River, is a landmark of Danyang. It is the largest freshwater ecological aquarium in Korea, where 23,000 domestic and foreign freshwater fish of 234 species swim leisurely in various tanks, including a large aquarium with a height of 8 meters. You can enjoy a fantastic underwater trip by encountering various domestic freshwater fish, including yellow mantis, silverfish, and leadfish, which are native fish of the Namhan River, as well as rare foreign freshwater fish, such as the Hongryong, the most protected species in China, and the Amazon giant piraruq, which are said to bring health and good luck. In addition, Danuri Aquarium's aquarium is decorated with the theme of the Eight Scenic Views of Danyang, providing another attraction. For children, it is a fountain of learning and an optimal ecological learning place, and for adults, it is a hall of memories and happiness where they can look back on their childhood days. Above all, since it is next to Danyang Intercity Bus Terminal, it is easy to find and has good accessibility, so many people come here.

title: Danyang Saineam
description: *Sainam Hermitage is a spectacular combination of strangely shaped rocks and a valley. *Sainam Rock is one of the eight scenic views of Danyang. It is a 70m high strangely shaped rock cliff along the deep blue stream along the Namjo Stream in the south of Danyang. Sainam is located on the side of Namjocheon (aka Ungyecheon), where a wide rock like a folding screen forms a straight wall and boasts majesty. Sainam is a biotite granite from the Cretaceous period of the Mesozoic Era. The plate-shaped joints and vertical joints are well developed, making the granite body look like a square pillar. The granite body in this area has well-developed joints, including tors, on the upper part, forming a unique landscape, and is located near a river, where eroded landforms such as potholes and barrels are distributed. In addition, there is Cheongnyeonam Hermitage, a hermitage from the Goryeo Dynasty, and you can go trekking using the Seonamgol Ecological Trail, making it a place where many scenic values, culture, history, ecology, and geological values ​​are combined. * Origin of the name Sain-am * It is said that Jae-gwang Lim, who served as the governor of Danyang-gun during the reign of King Seongjong of the Joseon Dynasty, named it Sain-am because Woo-tak, a scholar from Danyang in the late Goryeo Dynasty and well-versed in epidemiology, stayed here while he was serving as an official of the fourth rank, ‘Sain,’ a position that assists the king.

title: Danyang River remnants
description: The Danyang River Trail, which is 1.2km long, has a trail along the rock wall of the Namhan River that has been difficult to access, allowing you to experience the romance and thrill of trekking with your whole body. By installing night lighting, it was selected as one of the top 100 night tours in 2020 and is leading Danyang-gun as a residential tourist city. Nearby attractions such as the Moss Tunnel, Mancheonha Skywalk, Suyang Gaeseon Relics Exhibition Hall, and Suyanggae Light Tunnel have also been created to provide experiences encompassing tourism, geology, and history.

title: Danyangjang (1st, 6th)
description: In Danyang-gun, there are five-day markets such as Danyang Market, Yeongchun Market, and Maepo Market, the largest of which is Danyang Market. Danyang Market is the largest traditional market in Danyang-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, and opens a five-day market on the 1st and 6th of every month. At any market, there are long lines of various agricultural and marine products, daily necessities, industrial products, etc., but vegetables and beans grown by rural seniors, and wild greens collected from Sobaeksan Mountain make you feel nostalgic for your hometown, and you can see old daily necessities (e.g., brooms, brooms, etc.) that cannot be found in large department stores or marts. In particular, garlic dumplings made with fillings kneaded with directly boiled garlic oil are popular. ◎ Travel information to discover the charms of the Korean Wave Enhyphen’s own content is the first market we visited upon arriving in Danyang. There are plenty of foods to taste in Danyang, including black garlic chicken gangjeong, which Seonwoo was looking forward to from the taxi, as well as bugak, pancakes, makgeolli, and boiled Neungi duck.

title: Dalseong Park
description: Dalseong Park, the oldest urban park in Daegu, contains traces of history. Dalgubeol's earthen fortress, originally an old tribal nation in Daegu, is a fortress built in the earliest period in the history of castle development in Korea, and the name Dalseong Park also comes from the earthen fortress. Dalseong Park is located in the center of the city, so transportation is convenient, and there are historical sites within the park, so it is used as an educational center for children and youth. In addition, it is popular with families as it has a harmony of rare large trees and landscaping trees, and a zoo where you can see deer, ostriches, seals, tigers, etc. There are many benches and rest areas here and there, and there is a path that goes around the park, making it great for taking a leisurely stroll.
priceDetail: Free

title: Dakmeor Coastal Road
description: The section from the entrance to Dakmeoru to Sinchon Port has an observatory and walking path connected to a wooden deck, and fall to early winter is a good time to visit the Dakmeoru coastal road. Dakmeor Rock was named so because it resembles a chicken digging up the soil and sitting in it. This place, which boasts a beautiful sea view, is already well known to local residents, but is not yet well-known to travelers. Therefore, it is the perfect place to enjoy a quiet walk and take pictures. In the area where the Dakmeor Rock is located, there is a road made of wooden decks, and there is a coastal pavilion at the end of the road. The path leading to the coastal pavilion is filled with silver grass that has become abundant in the fall, creating a great backdrop for taking pictures. In particular, this is a popular sunset spot, so it is recommended to take pictures just before the sun sets. Silver grass and the setting autumn sun will create a beautiful background and lighting. (Source: Jeju Culture and Tourism website)
priceDetail: Free

title: Damyang Meta-Provence
description: Meta Provence is a tourist complex built in Damyang, Jeollanam-do, visited by about 5 million tourists annually. It is located right next to Damyang Metasequoia Road, which has been selected as the most beautiful tree-lined road in Korea. It has the feel of a replica of Provence, a French city famous as a resort. Meta Provence is comprised of an open space where culture, art, and business coexist, including a fashion street, design workshops and experience centers, commercial spaces, and banquet halls for individual tourists as well as families and club tourists. We strive to provide special memories and new experiences to everyone who visits us through diverse and differentiated high-quality services.
priceDetail: Free

title: Dangnamri Island
description: Dangnam-ri Island, located in Daeshin-myeon, Yeoju-si, Gyeonggi-do, is a representative landscape agricultural complex in the metropolitan area and is famous for a variety of flowers blooming seasonally, such as rape flowers, lavender, buckwheat flowers, cosmos, and pink muhly. Yeoju City also planted rapeseed flowers, pink muhly, and kenaf on an area of ​​approximately 14,700 m2 this spring. The largest Kenyan forest in the country, an environmentally purifying plant that absorbs more than five times more carbon dioxide, is being created.

title: Anchor Art Museum
description: The Anchor Art Museum opened in October 2010 to practice sharing through art, focusing on photography and books. It is an organic space where inner reflection takes place through creative experiences outside the time and space of the modern city. Utilizing a large site surrounded by forests, we introduce exhibitions that resonate with nature and art, and operate a frame wild garden, woodworking shop, photography studio, residency, and greenhouse. In addition, the Anchor Art Museum, a small art museum in the forest, is a place where you can escape from your busy daily life and relax while looking at the works on display.

title: Daegwallyeong Sheep Ranch
description: It is a ranch specializing in animal welfare and forest conservation designated by the Korean Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry. Sheep graze freely on large pastures. The ranch, which completed its first barn in 1989 and introduced sheep in 1991, has grown into a ranch with the highest level of sheep breeding system in Korea. There are two main things to enjoy at Daegwallyeong Sheep Farm: walking on a trail and feeding. You can walk along trails where wild plants grow and meet flocks of sheep grazing in the grasslands. For reference, sheep are grazed from mid-May to late October when grass grows in the pasture, and live in barns in the winter. There is a wooden hut at the beginning of the trail, and the Baekdudaegan Mountain Range seen from 920m above sea level, the midpoint of the trail and the top of the ranch, refreshes the congested heart.

title: Daegu Seomun Market & Seomun Market Night Market
venue: Daegu Seomun Market & Seomun Market Night Market
description: Seomun Market, said to be Daegu's largest market, was relocated to its current location in the 1920s by reclaiming the Emperor's Hall site and has a long history. The three major markets of the Joseon Dynasty were Daegu, Pyongyang, and Ganggyeong. Because it was located on the west side of Daegu Fortress, it was called Seomun Market. At first, the motorcycle alley around Bonjeon Coffee Shop in Marketbuk-ro, about 300 meters away from the fortress, was the market, and it is said to be open on the 2nd and 7th of every month. The alley names of Hongdukkaejeon and Chicken Jeon remain to this day. Textile-related items are the main products, and the scale is so large that there is everything including castings and fabrics, fabrics, fabrics, crafts, men's and women's clothing, dishes, and dried seafood. It has a warm atmosphere and is conveniently equipped with heating and cooling facilities and a large parking lot.

title: Daegeum Cave (Daeiri Cave Area)
description: Daegeum Cave, located in the Daeiri Cave area in Samcheok-si, Gangwon-do, was formed at a similar time as the nearby Hwanseon Cave and Gwaneum Cave. It was opened to the public after a total of 7 years of preparation, including 4 years for the cave's discovery and 3 years for the installation of facilities. Inside the cave, cave formations such as stalactites, stalagmites, and stone columns are well developed. In particular, a large amount of cave water of unknown origin flows underground, forming several large and small waterfalls and cave lakes. The topography of this place is an area where the Pungchon Formation and Atmospheric Rocks of the Joseon Supergroup, a sedimentary rock class of the Lower Paleozoic Era from the Camburian to the Ordovician Period, are distributed about 530 million years ago. The topography, including coral reefs deposited in the deep tropical sea, reached its current location due to tectonic changes and eroded over a long period of time to form caves. Currently, Daegeum Cave is only accessible by monorail, and you must make an online reservation at least one day before your visit to enter.

title: Daedong Department Store
description: Daedong Department Store, located in Changwon City, was established in September 1990, and has become a shopping space for local residents, and at times a place for residents as a various cultural space, and a new resting place for local residents. There are about 300 brands, selling a variety of products that meet customer needs. In addition, we run a program called the Moon Knight Festival four times a year that provides discounts, attractions, and memories to become more friendly and strengthen bonds with local residents.

title: Daedunsan Cable Car
description: Daedunsan Cable Car began operation in November 1990. It is a two-way cable car with a track length of 927m and an incline of 23 degrees, with two cars crossing each other. It is a comfortable and safe cable car that can allow up to 50 people to reach the upper station in about 5 minutes. Daedun Mountain's majestic mountain range and strangely shaped rocks, seen from the cable car, spread out like a folding screen, creating a spectacular view. The mountain view seen from the top of the cable car is an unexplored area comparable to Mt. Geumgangsan, and the Geumgang Cloud Bridge and Samseon Cloud Bridge above are considered famous attractions. Cable car boarding passes can be issued sequentially on the day of boarding, and advance reservations are not possible.

title: Daebudo
description: Daebudo Island, called the Hawaii of Ansan, is an island connected to the mainland by the Sihwa seawall, but the romance and lyricism of the island still remain in many places. Above all, on the way to Daebudo Island, you can enjoy a unique drive that connects islands. If you cross Seonjae Bridge from Daebudo Island, you will enter Seonjae Island, and if you cross Yeongheung Bridge from Seonjae Island again, you will enter Yeongheung Island. Tando Island, said to have black stones, Buddha Island, where Buddha appeared, Seongamdo Island, where immortals roamed, Yukdo Island, so-called because six islands stand shoulder to shoulder like brothers in the West Sea, and Pungdo Island, which has a unique lifestyle of moving to nearby Dorido Island to collect oysters and clams in winter and returning before the Lunar New Year the following year, is a place that retains its unique charm. Daebudo Island is a place where you can enjoy the mud flat experience on the wide mud flat, and the sunset. The scenery at dusk is beautiful, and the clam kalguksu and clam grill restaurants lined up along the coast are also famous, making it a popular day outing course for citizens of the metropolitan area.

title: Daebusan Mountain
description: Daebusan Mountain is a mountain located on the border of Seorak-myeon, Gapyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do and Okcheon-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, and is 743m high. It is a peak rising to the south of Yumyeongsan Mountain and is called Daebusan Mountain because it is a mountain that separates Seorak-myeon and Okcheon-myeon along with Yumyeongsan Mountain opposite it. The mountain group consisting of Daebusan Mountain, Yumyeongsan Mountain, Eobisan Mountain, Sogunisan Mountain, and Yongmunsan Mountain boasts rare scenery in Gyeonggi-do. Daebusan has another name, Eobisan. A long time ago, it was said that fish would swim over the mountain during floods, so it became Eobisan Mountain. That's why this mountain has the name Bannermijae. Bannermijae has the meaning of ''the hill that ships used to cross''. Daebusan Mountain is also famous for its silver grass. Before silver grass took over this mountain, this was a place where slash-and-burn farmers set fires to cultivate their fields. Then, in the 1960s, after the slash-and-burn farmers left, it was occupied by highland vegetables, and about 20 years ago, it became a silver grass field. Below the eastern summit of Daebusan Mountain is an open silver grass plain. Daebusan Mountain was also the filming location for the movie 'Counseling', and the set of Neowajip remains. To get to Daebusan, take National Highway No. 6 toward Yangpyeong-eup, turn left at the Goeup intersection in Okcheon-myeon, go straight past Okcheon Naengmyeon Village, and pass Seolmaejae Natural Recreation Forest to reach the summit of Bannermijae.

title: Daeyupyeong Park
description: Daeyupyeong Park is a large park located in Jangan-gu, Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-do, and is a green space created for citizens' leisure and relaxation. It has a large lawn and a walking path, and is in harmony with the surrounding natural environment, allowing you to enjoy a pleasant rest in the city. Because of its good accessibility, it is suitable for various activities such as family outings, walks, and exercise.

title: Daejeon Station East Square
description: Daejeon Station East Plaza is located in Soje-dong, Dong-gu, Daejeon. It is a square with a different atmosphere from West Square, which is lined with restaurants, bars, and other food establishments. This is a meeting plaza for people going to and from Daejeon Station. It is the gateway you must pass through when getting on or off the train, and there are many parking facilities nearby. In addition, the Hoguk Railroad Plaza, a neighborhood park with sculptures, has been created, so the west plaza is called Daejeon Station Square and the east plaza is called the Hoguk Railroad Plaza. It is also good to enjoy other courses starting from Daejeon Dong Square.
priceDetail: Free

title: Daejeon O World
description: Daejeon O-World is the largest complex theme park in the central region, consisting of Zoo Land, Flower Land, Joy Land, Bird Land, and Night Universe. Zoo Land has a space where you can see various animals, including the Korean Wolf Safari and African Safari. At Joyland, you can enjoy thrilling rides such as Giant Drop, Flume Ride, and Super Viking. Flower Land is a garden-type space where flowers, water, and light are in harmony, and at Bird Land, you can experience rare birds and a tropical garden. Night Universe provides nighttime content based on digital media, such as hologram shows and musical fountain water shows.

title: Daecheon Beach
description: Daecheon Beach is located in the area of ​​Beach 4-gil, Boryeong-si, Chungcheongnam-do. It is the largest beach on the west coast and has been established as a resort complex for foreigners since the 1930s. The white sand beach is 3.5km long and 100m wide. The slope is gentle and the sand is clean. The sunset that matches Dabodo Island is especially beautiful. Daecheon Beach is largely divided into the Sunset Square and Mud Square areas, and each offers different things to enjoy during the summer vacation season. The Boryeong Mud Festival, held every year, attracts the attention of people not only domestically but also around the world. A variety of events will be held with the theme of Boryeong’s mud, including the Mud Checkpoint and Mud Discotheque. At the end of the beach is the Boryeong Mud Experience Center. Mud sauna, mud ondol room, mud self-pack, and mud massage are available. There are many things to enjoy at Daecheon Beach other than swimming. Daecheon Ziptrek gives you the thrill of rushing into the sea. Sky Bike is the nation's first maritime rail bike that travels between Daecheon Beach and Daecheon Port. A track was installed at a height of 8 to 15 meters above the water to run along the sea road. It is a 2.3km round trip in 40 minutes, and if possible, it is recommended to ride during high tide when the sea is full.
address: 123 Mud-ro, Boryeong-si, Chungcheongnam-do, South Chungcheong Province

title: Daecheon Beach Sky Bike
description: Daecheon Beach Sky Bike is Korea’s first sea sky bike. You can ride your bike for about 40 minutes along the 2.3km round-trip rail from Daecheon Beach to Daecheon Port. The advantage is that you can run while admiring the scenery of the sea off Daecheon. The minimum number of people per bike is 2 and a maximum of 4 people can ride. Reservations are not possible, and tickets can be issued on-site only on the day. Infants and toddlers can also ride when accompanied by a guardian.

title: Daepo Columnar Joint
description: The waves crashing refreshingly to open up the blocked heart, and the columnar joints on the coast of the eastern part of the Jungmun Tourist Complex, surrounded by dark red hexagonal stone pillars stacked elaborately as if carved by God, like a folding screen, are a natural tourist resource where you can feel the greatness and exquisiteness of nature at the same time, and are a designated cultural heritage monument of Jeju Island. When you look at the columnar joints formed due to tectonic shifts in the distant past, it seems as if the sad story of a mason is immediately conveyed in the white crumbling foam. When the waves are strong, they create a spectacular sight with waves rising more than 20 meters high. It is a popular attraction as a theme travel destination due to its natural scenery. Columnar jointing is a vertical joint in the shape of a column that appears mainly in basaltic lava flows and is polygonal (usually 4 to 6 polygonal). It is said that it is formed as a result of the contraction that occurs when thick lava (about 1,100 degrees Celsius) flows from the crater and cools rapidly. It is the largest in Korea, measuring 30 to 40 meters and about 1 km wide.

title: Daeheungsa Temple (Haenam)
description: Daeheungsa Temple, located on Mt. Duryun, is a temple said to have been founded by Adohwasang in the 22nd year of King Seong of Baekje, and was registered as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2018 under the name of Korea's Mountain Monastery. Daeheungsa Temple is a temple where the spirit of Buddhism to protect the nation is alive and well, and is where the headquarters of the monks led by the Great Master Seosan was located during the Japanese invasions of Korea. And Zen Master Choui, who believed that tea contained all the truth of Buddha and the joy of meditation, went into the valley of Daeheungsa Temple, built Iljiam Temple, and devoted himself to meditation alone for over 40 years. As a result, Daeheungsa Temple became a sacred place for Korean tea culture. At Daeheungsa Temple, there are relics such as the National Treasure Daeheungsa North Amuleukam Rock-carved Buddha Statue, as well as the Seosan Daesa Relics Hall, which are gifts from our ancestors such as jade feet and jade feet, Seosan Daesa's handwriting, gyoza, shoes, and Buddhist sutras written in gold and silver.

title: The Bay 101
description: The Bay 101 is a complex cultural and artistic space boasting the night view of Haeundae, where the beautiful sea, mountains, and modern buildings coexist. It is a famous tourist attraction in Busan where you can see colorful skyscrapers at night, and is located at the entrance to Dongbaek Island in Haeundae. The Bay 101 has a variety of facilities, including a cafe where you can enjoy brunch and drinks while looking at the Haeundae city view, a restaurant with a terrace and rooftop, a prop shop where you can find various props and kitchenware, and a gallery. Additionally, they operate a yacht tour, so you can enjoy the beautiful night view of Haeundae from a yacht. It is also a famous photo zone for taking great pictures of Haeundae's night view or skyscrapers, so many tourists visit it. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - The Bay 101, where Geumju and Big Hands from the drama <Strong Woman Gangnam Soon> enjoyed a yacht tour and talked about Brad Song, is a place where the ocean view and city view of Busan come together. Let’s enjoy a luxurious Busan night while riding a yacht on the sea of ​​Haeundae.

title: The Hyundai Seoul
description: Seoul is the core of global trend K-content, and at its center is the ultra-modern flagship store The Hyundai Seoul. The Hyundai Seoul presents a vision for a happier tomorrow and a new standard of life under the slogan, “Resounding toward the future.” With innovative space design, world-class content curation, and futuristic technology, The Hyundai Seoul is Seoul's largest new global landmark. It boasts an innovative interior design that meets new materials, balances surfaces and lines, and fills it with light. At The Hyundai Seoul, you can see the trends of world-class interior and architectural design at once. The moment you enter, you will encounter Sounds Forest and Waterfall Garden. The unexpected nature found in high-tech buildings designed with an eye to the future is surprisingly beautiful. The large indoor garden of about 1,000 pyeong, natural lawn, and natural light coming from the 20 m high glass ceiling convey the echo of the forest. Art is the largest category of language that can be felt and empathized without having to say anything. The three-dimensional exhibition measuring 180 pyeong is overwhelmingly inspiring the moment you enter. Inspiration for a better life and communication for culture begin here. Unite & Shine, STUDIO SWINE Studio Swine's artwork, which is completed with designs containing messages from nature and the audience enjoying and feeling them, meets high-end brands on the Exclusive Label (1F) floor.

title: Deokgu Hot Springs Spa World
description: Deokgu Hot Springs Spa World is the first national health hot spring in Gyeongsangbuk-do recognized by the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs, and is a natural gushing hot spring harmonized with the beautiful natural scenery of about 4,000 pyeong halfway up Eungbong Mountain. The temperature is the natural temperature without heating or cooling, and it is slightly alkaline and contains a lot of ingredients such as sodium bicarbonate, potassium, calcium, iron, and carbonic acid. It is especially effective in treating adult diseases such as neuralgia, arthritis, muscle pain, skin diseases, and diabetes. It is also a place that evokes admiration as it is composed of a beautiful canyon with a world-class view, including the sight of a hot spring where natural hot spring water gushes out naturally, strangely shaped rocks, and clear valley water.
address: 924, Deokgu Oncheon-ro, Buk-myeon, Uljin-gun, Gyeongsangbuk-do, Gyeongsangbuk-do

title: Deokso Natural History Museum
description: Deokso Natural History Museum collects from over 30 countries around the world over a long period of time and collects a huge number of real specimens and fossils, including 5 authentic dinosaur fossils, 500 other fossils, 350 minerals, 2,200 fish and shellfish, 90 stuffed animals, 1,200 insects, 100 immersion specimens, and 50 Cenozoic mammal skeletons, with advice from experts in each field. It is exhibited academically. In addition, a small ecological park has been created to raise birds, mammals, and fish, and is an educational site where children and adults can learn and observe nature in a friendly way.

title: Deokjin Park
description: Jeonju has been a large-scale town in the Honam region since the Mahan era, and its name comes from Mahan’s Wonsanseong Fortress. It was the capital of Later Baekje for about 40 years, and during the Joseon Dynasty, it was renamed Wansanyusubu because it was the hometown of Lee Seong-gye's ancestor. One of the things to see in Jeonju that leaves a strong impression is the lotus flowers blooming in Deokjin Park. That's why Deokjin Park pond is Jeonju's famous attraction. Deokjin Park, located along Paldal-ro, which enters the city from Jeonju IC, was a natural lake formed during the Goryeo Dynasty and was created as an urban park in accordance with the citizen park decision notice in April 1978, and is a place with a deep history along with Chwihyangjeong. The 45,000 pyeong grounds are divided by a suspension bridge that crosses the pond, which occupies two-thirds of the area to the south, and the boat park to the north to the east and west. You can immerse yourself in endless poetry while walking along the arched suspension bridge in the center of a pond filled with scent. In particular, the characteristics of the park, which reopened in 1998 after extensive maintenance work, are reminiscent of small forests (hills) in rural areas through mounding construction, and maximized historicity by creating a traditional pavilion and a iris wetland. In addition, an artificial waterfall and a wooden bridge were installed to create a nature-friendly facility to suit the sentiments of citizens. It is also famous for the Dano Iris Water Festival, where women wash their hair with pond water early in the morning and pray for good health for the new year.
address: 390, Gwonsamdeuk-ro, Deokjin-gu, Jeonju-si, Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province
priceDetail: Free

title: Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum
description: Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum is located at the foot of Gungeryi Mountain and is where Beombawi Cave is located. Over 3,000 species of plants, including oak, fir, chestnut, and pine trees, grow naturally, and dozens of species of native wild flowers are distributed. In addition, about 1,000 species of succulents and cacti are managed in the greenhouse, and there are about 100 species of tropical plants that are difficult to find in Korea, such as coffee trees and papayas. Out of the 250,000 square meters of Deokpyeong Dinosaur Arboretum, 130,000 square meters are in an undeveloped natural state and serve as a refreshing forest bathing area, and in the remaining space, dinosaurs, the main theme, are created within the arboretum, providing fun and memories for children and families. The insect museum provides an educational experience where you can see the fascinating lives of insects and an opportunity to experience emotional connection with animal friends.

title: Deokpojin Education Museum
description: Deokpojin Education Museum, opened in 1996, is located in Daegot-myeon, Gimpo-si, Gyeonggi-do, and is a private museum run by directors Kim Dong-seon and Lee In-sook, who were elementary school teachers. In 1990, when his wife, Director Lee In-sook, lost her eyesight in a car accident, her husband, Director Kim Dong-seon, founded the museum with the educational materials and severance pay he had collected to keep his promise to “let students meet again.” It consists of a total of three floors, and the first floor of the museum is the character education center, which displays name tags, report cards, and student ID cards, which are memories of old school days. The 2nd floor is an educational history museum, and displays materials related to the 1st to 7th curriculum from the Japanese colonial period and objects that adults can now reminisce about. The 3rd floor agricultural culture museum displays a variety of objects that can help you learn about the agricultural culture and the traditional culture of our ancestors. Deokpojin Education Museum operates a variety of experience programs. Major programs include School Bell Tinting, which involves listening to teacher Lee In-sook's organ singing class in an old classroom, followed by a tour of the museum, and Humanities on the Road to the Museum, where the theme changes every year.

title: Delpino Hotel & Resort Ocean Play
description: Delfino's Ocean Play is a water theme park consisting of an indoor water park and an open-air bath. With the concept of well-being where rest and health coexist, it is a place where families and couples can escape from everyday life and enjoy nature. Ocean Play, located on the first floor of the Sono Felice facilities building, is divided into an indoor zone, an outdoor zone, and a hot spring sauna. Before using the pool, you can take a light shower in the sauna and then go straight to the indoor zone to play. When you enter the indoor swimming pool, you can play in the water while looking at the beach in the distance through the open glass window, so it has a really nice view compared to other swimming pools. The depth of the water is shallow, about 1 meter, so it is safe for children to play in the water, and the water is also lukewarm, so they can play in the water without being cold when playing indoors. Life jackets and tubes can be rented at rental shops. Main facilities include a kids play pool where children can play in shallow water, a kids river, and an outdoor infinity pool.

title: Dodamsambong
description: Dodamsambong is where Jeong Do-jeon, who contributed to the founding of Joseon, spent his childhood, and it is said that he fell in love with the beauty of Dodamsambong to the point that he called himself Sambong. You can see the scenery of Dodamsambong loved by Toegye Yi Hwang, Gyeomjae Jeong Seon, and Danwon Kim Hong-do right before your eyes. Sambong Story Hall, located within the amusement park, exhibits Danyang's famous attractions as an archive. If you board the Hwangpo sailboat, you can go to Dodam Garden on the other side via Seokmun. Dodam Garden is famous for planting yellow cosmos. You can fully experience the beauty of nature along with the scenery of Dodamsambong Peak.

title: Dodram Mountain (Jeomyeong Mountain)
description: Jeomyeongsan Mountain is more commonly known as Dodramsan Mountain. Dodramsan Mountain's Dodram sound seems to have been modified over time. There is a legend that a long time ago, a high priest (also known as Hyoja) who lived in this mountain was digging for medicinal herbs when the rope that tied him to the cliff broke due to friction with the edge, putting his life in danger. A wild pig cried out of nowhere and saved the high priest's life. It faces Seolbongsan Mountain, located in the east of Majang-myeon, and is not very high at 49m above sea level, but the strangely shaped rocks that make up the peak create an exquisite scenery, making it a famous mountain in Icheon that attracts many hikers from outside. In particular, the taste of the cool and cool sarcophagus water that springs from under the cliff behind Yeongbosa Temple on the mountainside is exquisite, and the cuteness of hikers climbing the rocks along the ridge allows you to enjoy the pleasure of hiking. An interesting legend has been passed down that in the past, when the spirit of Samgaksan Mountain first built Samgaksan Mountain, he ordered Magohalmi to move Jiri Mountain and Dodeurambong Peak. While Magohalmi was dragging Dodeurambong Peak, she heard that Samgaksan Mountain was already completed and abandoned it in its place, which became the current Doderamsan Mountain. In an old document, it was said that there was a temple called Jeongaksa Temple on Jeomyeongsan Mountain, but it has now disappeared, and traces of the temple remain at the southern foot of the mountain, and this place is called Jeongakgol.

title: Domachi Valley
description: It is called the Domachi Valley in the northernmost part of Gyeonggi-do. If you pass the 3rd and 8th Bridge from Yongsu-dong Village, the last stop of the city bus toward Jeokmok-ri, Gapyeong, and climb endlessly up the uninhabited valley, you will be mesmerized by the scenery of the valley along the roadside. This is the only clean area in the province notified by the Environmental Protection Agency, and is home to the natural monument, scallop fish. There is a cow called Yongso 3km upstream from the 3rd and 8th Bridge. The water is deep and clear, and there is a legend that a pregnant woman found a dragon ascending to heaven, and the dragon fell and became a cow. If you continue going back for about an hour past Yongso, there are many large and small waterfalls and cows, and finally you reach a huge waterfall. There is a legend that in the old days, military officers enjoyed drinking and dancing with vegetables as snacks. It is a beautiful place with beautiful scenery and a place where you can feel the cold even in the middle of summer.

title: Dosan Seowon [UNESCO World Heritage]
description: In terms of its architectural structure, Dosan Seowon is largely divided into Dosan Seodang and Dosan Seowon, which encompasses it. Dosan Seodang is where Toegye personally lived and taught his students, and Dosan Seowon is a shrine and a seowon built after Toegye's death. Dosan Seodang was built by Toegye in 1561 (the 16th year of King Myeongjong's reign) for academic research and training of future generations. It is the oldest building in Seowon and is said to have been designed by Toegye himself. At this time, Nongunjeongsa Temple, which served as a dormitory for Confucian students, and Hagagojiksa, a facility inside Bujeon Church, were also built. Dosan Seowon was completed in 1576 (9th year of King Seonjo’s reign), six years after the death of Toegye. When Toegye passed away in 1570, it was decided to enshrine his memorial tablet at Sangdeoksa Temple in 1572. Two years later, with the support of local Confucian scholars, a shrine was built to enshrine the memorial tablet, and a Jeongyodang and east and west buildings were built to complete it as a seowon. In 1575 (the 8th year of King Seonjo's reign), it received a copy of 『Dosan Seowon』 written by Han Seok-bong and became a Saek Seowon, thereby serving as the headquarters of Confucianism in Yeongnam. In 1615 (the 7th year of King Gwanghaegun's reign), Sarim paid tribute to Jomok, and in 1792 (the 16th year of King Jeongjo's reign), King Jeongjo issued a royal ceremony and implemented Dosanbyeolgwa. In 1796 (the 20th year of King Jeongjo's reign), the Sisadan (試士壇) was established, and in 1819 (the 19th year of King Sunjo's reign), Donggwangmyeongsil (東光明室), a library, was built. In 1870 (the 7th year of King Gojong's reign), it was excluded from Daewongun's order to abolish academies. In 1930 (the year of Gyeong-oh), Seogwangmyeongsil (西光明室) was rebuilt, and in 1932 (the year of Imsin), Hagojiksa (lower temple) was relocated. In 1969, 19 lots (324,945㎡) of forest and fields centered around this academy were designated as historic sites, and from 1970, repair and expansion projects were carried out by presidential decree, making it a sanctuary as a spiritual home of Korean Confucianism. In 1977, the Dosan Seowon Management Office was established, and after the enactment and promulgation of the management and operation ordinance, it has continued to this day.◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - This is a place where the 16th cast of the entertainment show <I am Solo> wore hanbok and were randomly matched with partners. It is also a place where viewers vicariously felt excitement and tension whenever a partner is chosen based on the color of clothes, regardless of one's will. If you walk along the nearby trail, you can see not only the inside of the Seowon but also various specialties of the Seowon, such as Wangbeodeul and Sisadan.

description: Dowon Sports Park is a park in the city with a variety of sports facilities. It is popular with families as it has sports facilities that anyone can use, such as tennis courts, soccer fields, tracks, and basketball courts, as well as a children's playground and a water park that operates in the summer. The wide walking trail is suitable for a quiet walk. Nearby, there is the Hyangnam Multipurpose Gymnasium and the Hwaseong City History Museum, making it a great place to visit together, and is perfect for a family outing.

description: The Independence Hall of Korea was built on August 15, 1987, with generous donations from the people, with the purpose of establishing the identity of the national culture and contributing to establishing the people's solid national spirit and national outlook by collecting, preserving, exhibiting, researching, and researching data on our people's overcoming the national crisis and the history of national development, which overcame the outcry and protected the nation's independence and independence. The Together Independence Movement Experience Center, located within the Independence Hall of Korea, is an experience center where you can learn about the history of the independence movement to reclaim our country in an easy and fun way while feeling the love for your country. It can be used by all generations, from infants to adults. Various experience facilities have been created so that you can play games that stimulate your five senses in a space decorated with national symbols such as the Rose of Sharon and the Taegeukgi, and become an independence activist yourself and indirectly participate in the independence movement to feel the joy of the liberation of your country and the Republic of Korea developing into the world. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Entertainment <2 Days of Stone> Independence Hall, where you can meet the passionate history of Koreans who created K culture, reveals its majesty even from afar. Gyeore’s Pagoda and Gyeore’s House, the largest tiled building in Asia. We recommend feeling the K-spirit by looking around the Unification Garden and the Unification Bell, where ATEEZ performed the Golden Bell.

title: toxic acidity
description: Doksanseong Fortress is a fortress from the Three Kingdoms period located in the area of ​​Jigot-dong, Osan-si, Gyeonggi-do. It was built at the top of Doksan Mountain, and was first built during the Baekje period and was used until the Unified Silla, Goryeo, and Joseon periods. The circumference is about 1.1km. At the top, there remains the site of Sema Daejeon, where General Kwon Yul used his outstanding strategy during the Japanese invasions of Korea. From here, you can enjoy a panoramic view of not only the city of Osan but also Siwon and Hwaseong. The walking trail connects to the old Gyeonggi Road, and the Doksanseong Forest Bathing Area has been created below the fortress wall, offering a variety of things to enjoy.

title: Doksanseong Forest Bathing Site
description: Doksanseong Forest Bathing Area is a forest bathing area built on 207,000 m² of forest around Doksanseong Fortress and Seema Daeji in Osan City. Opened in 1999, it is used as a space for mental and physical training and relaxation for Osan citizens and as a nature experience center for children. There is an observatory, a rest area, a classroom in the forest, a picnic area, and a tree observation trail, as well as various physical fitness facilities and adventure equipment. If you apply for the ‘Historical Exploration Course’ and ‘Wide Course’ of Osan City Tour, you can experience both a walk along the Doksanseong Forest Bathing Trail and a Doksanseong Fortress Tour.

title: Dolsan Park
description: Dolsan Park is a park that can be found as soon as you cross Dolsan Bridge and enter Dolsan Road from downtown Yeosu. It was built in 1987 on a site of approximately 87,000 pyeong. In the park, the set filming site for the 2004 SBS morning drama ‘Choice’ was set up and is visited by many tourists. Part of the set was converted into a traditional tea house, so the scenery of drinking tea while looking at Dolsan Bridge is beautiful. The view from the park's viewpoint is also spectacular, including the sunset over Dolsandaegyo Bridge, the night view of Dolsandaegyo Bridge, the night view of the marine park encompassing Jungang-dong and Jonghwa-dong in Yeosu, and the night view of Janggun Island. At the central site of the park, various materials related to the 1994 Samyeo integration are stored in a time capsule, which is scheduled to be opened 100 years later on April 1, 2098.

title: Donggwang Theater
description: Donggwang Theater is one of the few remaining single-screen theaters that still retains its original appearance. The movie ticket sales counter that was used in the past is no longer in use, but the showtime schedule board that has been in use for a long time is hanging there. When you step inside, you see green floors and colorful neon signs. The movie theater scene of the drama ''Reply 1988'' was filmed here. The concession stand at the movie theater is like a supermarket, so you can bring out the drinks you want and popcorn is returned in the microwave. On one side, there is a tank with unusually large fish. Movie tickets can only be purchased in person, and seats cannot be designated, so you can sit wherever you like after entering. There is a soft sofa seat in the front so you can watch a movie comfortably.

title: Dongmun Traditional Market
description: Dongmun Traditional Market is a traditional market with a long history and is one of the representative markets of Jeju Island. Along with Dongmun Traditional Fish Market, it constitutes the most important and large-scale permanent traditional market in Jeju Island. It was first formed immediately after liberation in August 1945. This market was the only permanent market on Jeju Island at the time and became the base for all commercial activities on Jeju Island. When a large fire occurred in March 1954 and the entire market was reduced to ashes, it was moved to its current location in November of the same year. Main items handled include vegetables, fruits, marine products, medicinal herbs, grains, and clothing. As it is Jeju Island's representative traditional market, fresh seafood is popular. You can purchase a variety of assorted raw fish, including cutlassfish raw fish, at a low price, and fusion foods such as abalone intestine rice samhap and tteokgalbi with whole abalone are attracting attention.

title: Dongbaek Lake Park
description: Dongbaek Lake Park is an urban neighborhood park located between Dongbaek Station and Eojeong Station, and is characterized by the Dongbaek Circular Trail built along the lakeside. It is a space that can be enjoyed by families, couples, and visitors with dogs. There are tables and benches here and there, making it a great place to relax while appreciating the calm lake scenery. It is equipped with convenient facilities such as a deck rest area, outdoor exercise equipment, and a floor fountain, and a musical fountain show is operated from June to July to add to the enjoyment of walking. Performances and events are regularly held on the outdoor stage and it is used as a leisure space for local residents.

title: Dongtan Lake Park Grand Passage
venue: Hwaseong Dongtan Lake Park Grand Passage
description: Dongtan Grand Passage is a complex cultural and shopping mall inspired by the architectural beauty of French streets, and has a themed space that reinterprets the Place de la Concorde and the Champs-Elysées. It consists of large commercial facilities, dining, and a medical center, and with 7 CGVs and trendy brands, it is bustling with activity on both weekdays and weekends. Inside the complex, there is an infinity pool overlooking Dongtan's first lake park, so you can enjoy shopping and leisure together. Due to its location adjacent to the lake park, there is high demand for visitors, and public transportation accessibility is expected to be further expanded when the tram opens in the future.

title: Dongpirang Village
description: The name ‘Dongpirang’ was created by combining the words ‘east’ and ‘birang.’ ‘Birang’ is a Tongyeong dialect word for ‘vital’, and it is made by adding only ‘dong’ from the word ‘east’, so people came to call it ‘Dongpirang.’ The Green Tongyeong 21 Promotion Council gathered people nationwide to paint on Dongpirang Road in October 2007. Those people painted pictures all over the village walls, walls, roads, etc., and the seaside hill village was reborn as a painting. Dongpirang Alley has dozens of branches. There are paintings in every alley, a village that touches the sky, and the paintings there are enough to turn the village into a fairyland. Additionally, the Gangguan seascape seen from the village is also worth seeing.

title: Donghaksan Park
description: Donghaksan Park is a low mountain located in Seokwoo-dong, Hwaseong-si, adjacent to Dongtan. It is 121.3m above sea level, so anyone can climb it easily, and its small area makes it a good trekking course that takes about 40 minutes round trip. It is a neighborhood park with an artificial turf field, a viewing stand, a parking lot, and a forest trail. Reservations can be made for the grass field, and dogs must be refrained from entering the sports facility. However, dogs are allowed on the forest trails as long as they follow the pet ticket. Simple exercise equipment is provided along the forest trail.

title: Durumoe Museum
description: Durumoe Museum, located in the center of a forest bathing area in the ecosystem-rich Simni Valley, in Beopwon-eup, Paju-si, Gyeonggi-do, is a museum specializing in the history of folk life that the founders, Kang Wi-soo and Kim Ae-young, who were saddened by the disappearance of our ancestors' daily necessities due to the wave of modernization, have collected and displayed pieces of art over the past 30 years. Durumoe (周山) is the name of the founder's hometown village, located within the Military Demarcation Line in North Korea. It is said to be located in Jangdan-gun. It is also used as a picnic course for elementary school students. Until recently, our traditional household utensils that were used in daily life have become so widespread and universal that their value as historical relics has been neglected, and in the present, damage and loss have intensified, putting them in danger of extinction. Accordingly, the Durumoe Museum focuses on collecting remnants of traditional household utensils, including jangdokdae, earthen dams, ssarimun, teojugari, upyanggari, seonangdan, shrines, jangseung, and jangseung. Folk cultural assets such as sotdae, barns, traditional mills, and coffee huts have been restored and are on display. The back enclosure of the jangdokdae, the jangdokdae located on the sunny side with an earthen wall, the large and small pots and clay pots sitting in a row in order of height centered on a straw rag, etc., are imbued with the breath of our ancestors; It has characteristics that are harmonious and compatible with nature. At the Durumoe Museum, you can encounter things from your hometown that have remained in the past, such as jars, thatched rooms, mills, and barns.

title: Lotte World Adventure Busan
description: A world of magic and fantasy! Lotte World Adventure opened in Busan. It is prepared so that you can perfectly enjoy the refreshing feeling and thrill of the forest. When you think of 'amusement parks', you can always experience fun and exciting performances and parades. Busan Lotte World is located in Busan, the second largest city in Korea, and is conveniently accessible via public transportation, so it has been attracting a steady stream of visitors since the first day of its opening. Lotte World Busan is comprised of six theme zones. There is a talking tree in the center of the fairy village Tinker Falls zone, and this tree uses animatronic technology to tell stories about six themes in the park. Lory Castle in the Royal Garden Zone, located at the highest point in Lotte World, looks as if it is floating on water, and you can enjoy the panoramic view of Busan and the sea off Gijang at a glance. The excitement of other rides, especially representative attractions such as Giant Digger and Giant Splash, is already spreading through word of mouth. In addition to attractions for adults, there are also rides for families with children. It is placed indoors so that children can safely enjoy it regardless of the weather. ◎ Travel information to experience the charm of the Korean Wave - Lotte World Adventure Busan, where Joong-jung and Jun-hee from the drama <Strong Woman Gangnam-soon> enjoyed an enviable date, is a place where fairytale-like scenery, thrilling rides, and fantastic parades coexist. When I stand in front of the ‘Talking Tree’, I am reminded of the happy couple Joong-Joong and Jun-Hee exchanging rings.

Over 300 different brands are gathered in one place, including Asia's largest Nike Factory and the first indoor surfing shop in a shopping mall. It is adjacent to the Gyeongbu Expressway (Giheung IC), Yeongdong Expressway, and the Bundang-Suseo Road, so it is close and convenient to visit.

title: Lotte Premium Outlet Uiwang Branch
description: Lotte Premium Outlet Uiwang Branch is a shopping mall complex that provides new and enjoyable experiences every day. It is a space where you can relax and experience various experiences amidst nature (Barasan Mountain and Baekun Lake) that changes over time. Like the slogan ‘Every Single Moment’, you can enjoy shopping in a nature that changes with time.

title: Lotte Fitin Sanbon Branch
description: Lotte Fitin Sanbon Branch is a complex shopping mall located within walking distance from Sanbon Station, and is close to the local living area, making it highly accessible. From the 1st to the 10th floor, there are various stores including fashion, F&B, living, and home appliances, and Starbucks, Olive Young, Uniqlo, Lotte Super, and Hi-Mart are located there. Lotte Cinema operates on the 10th floor, and leisure facilities such as a golf academy and fitness center are also provided, allowing daily shopping and cultural activities to be enjoyed in one place.

title: Living Power Center
description: Living Power Center is Korea's first and largest living shopping mall specializing in home appliances and furniture, which opened in April 2020. It is operated under the concept of ‘All the living in the world in one place!’ and has a variety of stores, including home furnishings, home appliances, entertainment, F&B, and sports, from the 3rd basement floor to the 5th floor above ground. Beyond shopping, it functions as a complex cultural space that the whole family can enjoy together, and is highly accessible as it is only 3 minutes away from Giheung IC on the Gyeongbu Expressway.

title: Magoksa Temple [UNESCO World Heritage]
description: Gongju Magoksa Temple is a temple founded by Jajang in the 9th year of Queen Seondeok of Silla (640). It is said that the name Magoksa Temple was given by Bocheolhwasang of Silla because the congregation gathered when he was preaching was like the three generations of Sambat. At the time of its founding, it was a large temple with about 30 rooms, but now Daeungbojeon, Daegwangbojeon, Yeongsanjeon, Four Heavenly Kings Gate, and Haetalmun Gate remain. In addition, there is a five-story stone pagoda, a Buddhist hanging, a wooden plaque, the kite that King Sejo of the Joseon Dynasty rode, a bronze incense burner, and ancient books. There are also several manuscript Buddhist scriptures copied with gold and silver objects, a representative legacy of the Buddhist culture of the late Goryeo Dynasty. The area around Magoksa Temple is known as one of the Sipseungjijijis of the Joseon Dynasty, that is, one of the special areas where people could avoid danger during times of war. According to Lee Jung-hwan's 『Taekri』, Magoksa Temple escaped the Japanese invasions of Korea and survived the Korean War without suffering any damage. In recognition of its value, it was selected as a UNESCO World Heritage mountain temple and Korea's mountain monastery, and several cultural properties within the temple were designated as tangible cultural properties and cultural property materials of Chungcheongnam-do.
priceDetail: Free※Experience activities such as temple stay are charged separately.

title: Manas Art Center
description: Manas Art Center is an exhibition hall located next to the Namhan River in Byeongsan-ri, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do, where the water is clear and the air is good. It consists of the 700 pyeong Shona Sculpture Park and the 100 pyeong Makonde Sculpture Exhibition Hall. It is a famous place for African sculpture that owns and exhibits the largest number of Shona and Makonde sculptures in the country. The energy of African sculpture, completed through exchange with spirits, can be said to be the beginning of Cubism art, which conveyed the soul of art to Picasso. Manas Art Center is being reborn as a place where you can see the depth of African art.

title: Manisan (Ganghwa)
description: Manisan Mountain is one of the eight scenic spots of Ganghwa, and is also called Marisan Mountain, Marusan Mountain, and Duaksan Mountain. It is located at the southwestern tip of Ganghwa Island and in the center of the Korean Peninsula. It is also the highest in Ganghwa Island at 472.1m above sea level. At the top of Mt. Manisan, there is Chamseongdan, which is recorded as the place where Dangun Wanggeom offered his heavenly offering. The foundation is round to symbolize the sky, and the altar is square to symbolize the earth, forming a lower-upward shape. It is still a spiritual mountain of the nation where ancestral rites are held every National Foundation Day and where the National Sports Festival torch is lit and relayed here every year. If you climb the 918 stone steps along the hiking trail, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the West Sea at a glance.
operatingHours: 09:00~18:00 ※The entry time may change depending on the sunset time.

title: Midas Lake Icheon Golf & Resort
description: Midas Lake Icheon is a golf course that contains the beauty of nature as if it was hidden by God. Become the new protagonist of Midas Hand, who can achieve success in everything you touch through the optimal course composition to satisfy all golfers in the embrace of nature with a shining sun and ancient temples.

title: Midas Valley Cheongpyeong Golf Club
description: Midas Valley Cheongpyeong Golf Club is located in the last resort hidden by nature! It is the pinnacle of beauty gifted by nature, including a completely pollution-free and nature-friendly environment. The moment you step on the field, your new myth is born. A golf club built with perfect design and pure capital. It is a work of art that harmonizes the majesty that overwhelms the view of 18 holes as if each hole was made by the hand of God and the delicacy of a goddess. Midas Valley for your high-class life. We invite you to Cheongpyeong Golf Club.

title: Maisan Cherry Blossom Road
description: Maisan cherry blossoms are the last to bloom in the country thanks to the unique climate of the Jinan Plateau, and thousands of mountain cherry blossoms are in full bloom at once, creating a spectacular sight. The native wild cherry blossoms, which are 20 to 30 years old, are famous for their clear and vivid flower colors, and the 2.5 km cherry blossom road that runs from Isanmyo to Tapsa Temple is loved by many for its pink scenery. At Tapyeongje, you can enjoy a quiet atmosphere with the cherry blossoms as the peak of Maisan Mountain is reflected in the stagnant water. It is Jinan's spring flower spot, visited by tens of thousands of tourists, especially on weekends when the cherry blossoms are in full bloom.
priceDetail: Free

title: Majang Lake
description: It is a representative natural tourist destination in Paju where you can escape from the suffocating daily life and take a comfortable rest as if you are buried in the arms of nature, as it is located next to a mountain and a lake, and the water color and sunset are beautiful in harmony with the surrounding community trees and green mountains. Majang Lake, with its beautiful water scenery, has been created as an eco-friendly park and is the perfect place for an outing for families and couples. There is a 3.6km waterside deck and a 220m long suspension bridge where you can walk while looking at the waterside scenery. From the moment you cross the suspension bridge, the bridge shakes and shakes, eliciting gasps from tourists. Among the convenience facilities, there is a cafe located in the observatory and management building where you can enjoy a cup of tea while looking at the large lake. The camping site, which is a combination of a forest and a lake, provides a comfortable rest area while enjoying the sunset and early morning mist. You can also enjoy canoeing and kayaking at Majang Lake.

title: Mancheonha Skywalk
description: At Mancheonha Skywalk, located in Jeokseong-myeon, Danyang-gun, you can enjoy the thrill of walking on a skywalk while looking down 80 to 90 meters below the water from the cliffs of the Namhan River. In the spiral section leading to the observatory, you can enjoy the scenery from various angles, and when you stand at the observatory, you will be impressed by the view of the Namhangang River flowing across the ridge. If you go up to the observatory, you can see the panoramic view of the city and Sobaeksan Mountain Yeonhwabong in the distance. At the horseshoe-shaped Manhakcheonbong Observatory, you can experience the thrill of walking on the edge of a cliff while looking down on the Namhangang River flowing beneath you through high-strength triple-layer glass in the shape of three fingers, 15m long and 2m wide. Next to the observatory, there are various experience facilities such as a 980m long zip wire, a 1,000m long alpine coaster, and slides. ◎ Travel information to meet the charm of the Korean Wave - Entertainment <Point of Omniscient Interfere> This is the place where Lee Young-ja received a plaque of appreciation and Jeon Hyun-moo and Yoo Byeong-jae presented a congratulatory performance. Although it served as an event venue for entertainment, it is usually famous as an observatory with a panoramic view of Danyang. Many tourists visit here because they can enjoy not only the scenery but also various activities.

title: Mangsang Beach
description: Mangsang Beach is a national tourist site located about 3km north of Mukho Port and is a famous tourist destination on the east coast along with nearby Okgye and Gyeongpo. It has the widest and most comfortable environment among East Coast beaches, including a wide white sand beach, dense pine forest (20 to 30 years old), clean sea water, and shallow water (slope of 2 to 4 degrees, average water depth of 0.5 to 1.5 m). It is convenient for tourists to use as it is well-equipped with various convenience facilities such as parking lots, camping sites, showers, and public restrooms. There is an auto camping site right above the beach. It is popular with family tourists. There are many simple beaches (Nobong, Daejin, Eodal, Hanseom, Gamchu, and Chuam beaches) to the south, including the nearby Cheongok Natural Cave, Mureung Valley, and Chuam Candlestick Rock. Along with nearby Mukho Port, it is one of the coastal tourist destinations connecting Gangneung and Samcheok, and is full of abundance and abundance with abundant seafood such as squid, conches, sea cucumbers, sea squirts, and flatfish.

title: Mangwon Reservoir Sports Park
description: Mangwon Reservoir Sports Park is a sports park in Mangwon-dong that opened in 2004 by renovating a reservoir for flood control. In 2008, an inline skating track, a urethane athletics track for pedestrians, a soccer field of international stadium standards, and night lighting facilities were additionally installed. Currently, it has facilities such as a soccer field, foot volleyball court, basketball court, inline practice field, multi-purpose track, gateball field, and physical training equipment. There is a night lighting facility, so evening exercise is possible. Additionally, there is a small path between the sports parks, so you can see many citizens taking a walk.
